changed: RunEventType gains feature.fallback, ir.plan_compiled, ir.shadow_failed, ir.lineage_resolved and ir.step_verified; ReasonCode gains the fallback codes IR_TASK_UNRESOLVED, IR_COMPILE_FAILED and IR_VALIDATION_FAILED, which never end a run. New kernel/features.py: record_fallback(run, feature, reason) appends feature.fallback atomically and returns the updated run; the payload is exactly feature, reason_code and a fixed message from FALLBACK_MESSAGES; a non-fallback reason or an unknown feature raises KernelError(INVALID_REQUEST); a finished run raises CONFLICT. kernel.features joins a forbidden-import contract's source list (a restriction). OpenAPI and schema.ts regenerated; ui-core i18n labels and store handling for the five events, with a render test. Commits c14f9c7, e31020e, 5038b8f, fbc0466. Reviews: Codex rework R-1 High (free-text detail reached events and evidence) fixed in e31020e with a no-leak test on both stores; Codex re-review rework R-2 (plan widened ir.shadow_failed codes) fixed in fbc0466 and R-3 (pg evidence predated the fix) resolved by the final pg gate; Claude re-check accept.
open_items: Task 2c.5 gives ir.shadow_failed its fixed payload: IR_TASK_UNRESOLVED for an unresolved task, otherwise a stage (compile or validate) and a fixed message, never exception text.
Next: Task 2b.3 (toggles in readiness and evidence).

rulings.ruling: R-1: feature.fallback carries no caller text; the kernel owns one fixed message per fallback code, and ADR 0027 gets a dated note saying so.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A later task adds a strictly validated structured field.

rulings.ruling: R-2: ir.shadow_failed carries IR_TASK_UNRESOLVED only; compile and validation failures carry a stage, so the accepted ADRs stay unchanged.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: An ADR note adds two codes to ir.shadow_failed.

rulings.ruling: record_fallback takes the run first and returns the updated run, because the event moves the run revision.
